components.text:
Mysterious_w - Dream Strands (Desert Mix)  25th September 2004

This was originally an Aqua Mix, but I felt it missed something. I was fiddling around with various effects, tried out the invert and WHAM!, the desert mix was born. (The original mix also had me whining on about being a n00b too...)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  

 P A K - 9   
          ___   
       /___/|  
__ /  _   |  |________ 
   /  /_|   |  |_            /| 
 /  /__|   |/_/|         / /
 |____      _|/        / /
  AVS |__|/         / /
____________/ /         ===== >>> Dream Strands
____________|/          
                                  
Its a 'non-responder' but I like it. For chillout music obviously, nothing exceptional about the workings, it loops through colours with a ratio of 1 , 0.7 , 0.4 which have a nice neony (tm) glow to them.

Click the screen to toggle the more funky version.

code.onBeat:
ch1=rand(10)/100-0.05;
ch2=rand(10)/100-0.05;
beatcount=(beatcount+1)%freq;
code=if(equal(beatcount,1),(code+1)%6,code);
cred=
 equal(code,0)
+equal(code,1)
+equal(code,2)*0.7
+equal(code,3)*0.7
+equal(code,4)*0.4
+equal(code,5)*0.4;
cblue=
 equal(code,0)*0.7
+equal(code,1)*0.4
+equal(code,2)
+equal(code,3)*0.4
+equal(code,4)
+equal(code,5)*0.7;
cgreen=
 equal(code,0)*0.4
+equal(code,1)*0.7
+equal(code,2)*0.4
+equal(code,3)
+equal(code,4)*0.7
+equal(code,5);
